name: City Camp
street_address: Joslin Park (behind William D'abate School), Florence Street
description_short: A free day camp run by ECC for children ages 6-12 who live in the Olneyville and Manton neighborhoods of Providence. Each day starts and ends at Joslin Park, runs 10am-3pm, and includes field trips to places like ECC, the zoo and bowling.

sources.note: City Camp page: free day camp for campers living in Olneyville and Manton, Joslin Park on Florence Street, 10am-3pm, ages 6-12; page thanks families for 'another amazing summer' (2026)

warnings: Page shows no dates or season year; it says 'Thank you for another amazing summer!', so it reflects the summer that just ended (likely 2026), not the 2027 season.
